facts.fact: 章首为拍卖目录框架：Lot 12 是 1969 年 7 月采自多塞特莱姆里吉斯（Lyme Regis）海岸线的化石与石头，含一枚约 1.9 亿年的菊石；注记称『Mimi’s House Sea Glass design, now an iconic small-repeat pattern』的灵感来自同日拾得、『later lost』的一枚心形瓶绿色海玻璃。
facts.anchor: Lot 12: Fossils and stones from the coastline around Lyme Regis, Dorset, collected July 1969.

facts.fact: 去莱姆的路上 Lawrence 交代帮工缘由：『Only fair since we’ve stolen you』——他父亲觉得好笑，让 Alf 派他上最高的树挂 Mother 的小玻璃灯笼（他称 Terrifying）；Pamela 也让他干活，丢给他修枝剪却不警告棕榈叶缘是利刃，手侧落下一道口子还被当作『War wound, look!』炫耀，并说『It satisfied my father anyway』。Mimi 断定『Harold was a sadist』，并为 Pamela 对此只字未提而刺痛——『an omission that spoke of a growing distance』。
facts.anchor: Had Alf send me up the tallest trees to hang Mother’s little glass lanterns. Terrifying.

facts.fact: Lawrence 自陈被期望加入家族生意（『A somewhat less harmonious affair』）；问及生意做什么，他答『Money.』『Or it did. Until my father took the reins.』；父亲的蓝图（『Father’s blueprint for my life』）：扭转生意、替他收拾错误、却又要像他——他不明白这如何两立；母亲则『just insists I marry well and soon』；他说『I’m destined for other things, Miriam』，Mimi 以母亲那套『上帝的粉笔板会擦掉重写』打趣宽解。
facts.anchor: Turn the business around. Mop up his mistakes. But be like him.

facts.fact: 车内聊到婚嫁与爱情：Mimi 问『She likes Margo?』，Lawrence 惊讶她点出女友名（glances over, surprised），答『Loves her』；Mimi 谎称『That’s wonderful,』、自觉切破两人默契放进了太多现实，后悔提起 Margo；随后她自陈家里预期『work as gardeners, marry gardeners』、并宣称自己不会结婚（『I just don’t see why I’d ever want to.』），Lawrence 一句『Ah, you’ve never been in love, then.』收尾——车正好停进海滩车位。
facts.anchor: I lied, having cut into the silky conspiracy of the moment and let in too much reality. I regretted mentioning Margo.

facts.fact: 海滩上 Lawrence 跪在水边举起一枚『the size of a shilling』、蜷曲如秘密的菊石（先说世上最大蛾化石三年前在此出土，打赌那枚比这枚小菊石更壮观），递给 Mimi——她接过、低声念『Am-mon-ite』、在裙上擦干并与其他石头一起收进纸袋；他讲菊石得名于希腊羊角神 Ammon，随后又从浅水里捞出一枚心形翠绿海玻璃递给她——她自知会终生珍藏，把莱姆这一天封存在其中。
facts.anchor: drew out a sliver of emerald-green sea glass, shaped like a heart

facts.fact: 插叙出发时一幕：Lawrence 与 Mimi 驱车离开时望见 Pamela 与 Mackie 在草坪上踱步，Lawrence 倒车喊『Pamela!』并邀她搭车；Pamela 认出副驾上的 Mimi，沉脸质问『Miriam, what on earth are you doing in that dress?』，随即干脆拒绝——点明自己在工作、『madly busy for the party』，暗讽 Mimi 不然；车开走时她立在原地望着、Mimi 挥手她未回挥；Mackie 退后几步、双手插在短裤兜里，像学童般艳羡那辆银色敞篷——『It beat his Reliant Robin』。
facts.anchor: She stood very still, watching, her expression unreadable. I waved. She didn’t wave back.

facts.fact: Lawrence 眼睛半睁提议：『Hardly anyone around. If we stripped and ran in』——Mimi 在冲动与一连串顾忌间摇摆（想象 Pamela 嘶声叫 Miriam、父亲的拳头、『Whipple, who’d taken a punt on me, firing me on the spot』、Margo、Celia）；Lawrence 随即尴尬收回——『Let’s pretend I didn’t suggest it and grab lunch before we head back』；Mimi 跳起身，自知往后会一遍遍折磨自己：如果当时赤身奔进大海会怎样。
facts.anchor: If we stripped and ran in

facts.fact: 收尾：一阵风掀起 Mimi 自制棉裙的下摆，露出她与 Pamela 缀在裙上的姓名首字母——那一天缝进裙里的心绪已『A lifetime ago. I wasn’t that girl any more』；握着温热的海玻璃心她知道自己回不去了；Lawrence 慌乱间夸她『you look beautiful in it』，两人把炸鱼薯条残骸包进油报纸——『Parcelling up the day』，把这一天的全部野心思绪重新包好收拢。
facts.anchor: Parcelling up the day, all the wild feelings, until they were contained once more.

relations: Mimi（Miriam）Bramley ↔ Lawrence：互生情愫、『simply being understood』的海边一日；Lawrence 另有女友 Margo（Mimi 点名时他惊讶、答『Loves her』），Mimi 以谎掩饰并后悔提起。
Pamela ↔ Mimi：姐妹——同一条裙上缝着两人的姓名首字母；Pamela 未提及差遣 Mimi 帮工令 Mimi 刺痛（『an omission that spoke of a growing distance』）；海滩拒同车、不回挥手，神情『unreadable』。
Lawrence ↔ Harold（其父）：父亲觉得让 Lawrence 上树挂灯笼、替 Pamela 打下手的安排『seemed to find it amusing』（Mimi 判『Harold was a sadist』）；生意蓝图压顶——『Turn the business around. Mop up his mistakes. But be like him.』
Lawrence ↔ 其母：『Mother just insists I marry well and soon』；他打趣若能生出『four grandchildren, two girls … two boys』她该会满意。
Alf & Nancy：Mimi 家的双胞胎（Lawrence 挨个数 Bramley 家儿女时问『What about Alf?』，并说『twins are different, aren’t they?』，Mimi 答『They don’t really need anyone else』）；帮工时是 Alf 奉 Harold 之命派 Lawrence 上树。
Pamela ↔ Mackie：被预期的婚配——『Pamela’s destined to marry a Mackie sort』『Hopes are high』；本章两人同在草坪，Mackie 的座驾 Reliant Robin 被银色敞篷比下去。
两家身份：Mimi 家 = Bramley（Lawrence：『We’re lucky to have found you Bramleys』『I have no idea how any of you Bramleys survive the day』）；Lawrence 家 = Caswell（Mimi 想到家中 pressured 时期『a Caswell among them』即指他）。
次要提及：Whipple（『who’d taken a punt on me』、Mimi 想象裸泳被其当场开除——似有雇佣/提携关系）；Celia（裸泳顾忌名单之一）；Rafe（向 Mimi 提过 Lawrence 帮工一事；海玻璃被她比作『Rafe’s guitar plectrum』）。
numbers_dates: collected July 1969（化石采集年月，章首逐字）
an ammonite approximately 190 million years old（章首逐字：菊石年代）
turned up here three years ago（逐字节选：世上最大蛾化石在此出土距今三年，相对叙述时点）
the size of a shilling（Lawrence 捞起递给 Mimi 的菊石大小）
produce four grandchildren, two girls … and two boys（逐字节选：Lawrence 打趣的理想儿孙构成）
turning_point: Lawrence 半睁着眼提议两人脱光跑进海里（『If we stripped and ran in … ?』）又在尴尬中收回（『Let’s pretend I didn’t suggest it』），Mimi 跳起身、自知将终生回想『如果当时奔向大海会怎样』——全章蓄满的欲望在临界点被按下，与结尾两人把这一天『Parcelling up … contained once more』互为呼应。
